business_problem: Those sensors monitor key factors such as temperature, pressure, humidity and air quality. Honeywell’s existing data infrastructure was challenged to meet such demand.
solution_summary: Honeywell delivers industry-specific solutions that include aerospace products and services, control technologies for buildings and industry, and performance materials globally. Honeywell’s Energy and Environmental Solutions division uses IoT sensors and other technologies to help businesses worldwide manage energy demand, reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions, optimize indoor air quality, and improve occupant well-being. Accomplishing this requires Honeywell to collect vast amounts of data. Using Spark Declarative Pipelines on the Databricks Data + AI Platform, Honeywell’s data team can now ingest billions of rows of sensor data into Delta Lake and automatically build SQL endpoints for real-time queries and multilayer insights into data at scale — helping Honeywell improve how it manages data and extract more value from it, both for itself and for its customers.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Spark Declarative Pipelines
solution_components.role: Runs declarative batch and streaming transformations with less custom pipeline code.

data_flow: Source system and event data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services.
